body: Airbus has secured an order from US-based medical transport service firm Life Flight Network for five new H135 helicopters, with representatives of both companies finalizing the agreement on October 26 at the Air Medical Transport Conference in Fort Worth, Texas. The new twin-engine rotorcraft will support emergency transport for critically ill and injured patients across the Pacific Northwest and Intermountain West, serving communities in Oregon, Washington, Idaho and Montana with modern flight decks and dedicated clinical space.

The order builds on three H135s Life Flight Network ordered in 2025, bringing its total H135 orders to eight. The H135 offers a spacious, climate-controlled cabin, a high-set main rotor and a Fenestron shrouded tail rotor that improves ground safety during patient loading, along with the Helionix digital avionics suite and a four-axis autopilot that reduces pilot workload and improves safety in day and night missions in complex weather. Airbus says more than 1,500 H135 family helicopters are in service worldwide, logging more than 8 million cumulative flight hours.
en.summary: US medical transport provider Life Flight Network has ordered five Airbus H135 helicopters to support emergency medical missions across the Pacific Northwest and Intermountain West, bringing its total H135 orders to eight.
en.title: Life Flight Network orders five Airbus H135 helicopters for US air medical missions

body: 空中巴士獲得美國醫療運輸服務公司Life Flight Network訂購5架全新H135直升機的訂單，雙方代表10月26日在德州沃斯堡舉行的空中醫療運輸會議上完成協議。新機將支援太平洋西北地區與內陸山區的重症患者緊急運送，服務範圍涵蓋奧勒岡州、華盛頓州、愛達荷州與蒙大拿州，並配備現代化駕駛艙與專用醫療空間。

這批訂單建立在Life Flight Network於2025年訂購3架H135的基礎上，使累計訂購數達到8架。H135具備寬敞的恆溫客艙、高置主旋翼與Fenestron涵道尾旋翼，可提升病患裝載時的地面安全，並配備Helionix數位航電系統與四軸自動駕駛，有助降低飛行員負荷、提升晝夜與複雜天候任務的安全性。空中巴士資料顯示，全球服役中的H135家族直升機超過1,500架，累計飛行時數逾800萬小時。
zh.summary: 美國醫療運輸業者Life Flight Network向空中巴士訂購5架H135直升機，支援太平洋西北地區與內陸山區的緊急醫療任務；加上2025年訂購的3架，累計訂購數達8架。
zh.title: 空中巴士獲Life Flight Network訂購5架H135直升機，支援美國西北緊急醫療任務
